name: REvil
description: REvil (Ransomware Evil), also known as Sodinokibi, was a Russian ransomware-as-a-service group that emerged in 2019 as a rebranding of GandCrab, led by 'UNKN' (Daniil Shchukin). The group earned over $120 million in 2020 alone. REvil carried out the Kaseya VSA supply-chain attack ($70M demand) and the JBS Foods attack ($11M ransom). Dismantled in January 2022 when Russia arrested 14 members at US request, seizing $600K, 500K euros, and 426M rubles.

sources.title: At Request of U.S., Russia Rounds Up 14 REvil Ransomware Affiliates — Krebs on Security
